findings.note: ⚠ The finding's proposal wrote from:'spit-ambient-magic'; that would never fire. The ownership gate at build.ts:6551 tests `ownedIds.has(mod.from)` where ownedIds holds FEAT and CLASS-FEATURE ids only — draconic-paragon works because feats/kobold-breath is a feat, while spit-ambient-magic exists only in the actions bucket. `from` is therefore feats/ostilli-host-dedication (the grantsActions owner, and Deadly Mutation's printed prerequisite, so the gate can never wrongly withhold it) with actionRider.actionId naming the action row.
